overview_description.description:
DearBrightly offers prescription strength retinoids and a variety of other skincare essentials because we believe everyone deserves access to amazing skincare.

DearBrightly's mission is to educate and get people access to the most effective, dermatologist vetted prescription skincare products, using technology.

product.name: Night Shift Rx Face Serum
product.description: A tailored prescription-strength retinoid serum formulated with tretinoin and niacinamide to treat wrinkles, uneven skin tone, enlarged pores, and acne.

product.name: Rx Eye Serum
product.description: A tailored prescription-strength tretinoin serum formulated specifically for the delicate under-eye area to address fine lines, puffiness, and brightness.

product.name: Daily Sip Moisturizer
product.description: A moisturizer rich in ceramides and hyaluronic acid formulated to hydrate and support skin barrier health.

product.name: NeverSkip Tinted Mineral Sunscreen
product.description: A 100% tinted mineral sunscreen with broad-spectrum SPF protection designed for daily use to protect skin from UVA and UVB rays.
